edge.title: Graft #36's tuned aux AdamW (×1.3) onto MuonH; aux cooldown 0.85
edge.summary: MuonH itself is unchanged (Nesterov 0.95 + Newton–Schulz, hyperball step, lr 0.018 decaying linearly over the whole run). The change is in aux AdamW, which takes #36's tuned baseline values scaled up — embed 0.7→0.91 and scalars 0.015→0.0195 (×1.3), head 0.004→0.0064 (×1.6) — with weight decay 0.001 and a longer cooldown (last 85% instead of 40%); steps drop from 3325 to 3250. The script is the repo's refactored MuonH port, so the init also differs from #5's logged run: Gaussian std √(0.33/fan_in) with the same ×1.25/×3.0/×1.5 multipliers, all biases zero, and an LM head that is no longer zero-initialized (despite the retained comment).

changes.label: Aux weight decay 0 → 0.001
changes.detail: AdamW weight_decay = 0.001 (decoupled), applied to the embedding, LM head, gains and biases.

changes.label: Aux cooldown_frac 0.4 → 0.85
changes.detail: AdamW groups get group['cooldown_frac'] = 0.85 (flat for only the first 15%); MuonH keeps 1.0.

changes.label: LM head no longer zero-initialized
changes.detail: The init branch that zeroed 'proj' weights is gone, so proj.weight (LM head) gets N(0, 0.33/768), std ≈ 0.0207, although the comment still says it is zeroed.

changes.label: Gaussian base init, all biases zero
changes.detail: Hidden weights are N(0, 0.33/fan_in) (vs Kaiming-uniform 1/(3·fan_in) in #5) before ×1.25/×3.0/×1.5; all biases are zero (q/k/v/fc biases were default-uniform in #5).

changes.label: Single MuonH + updated skeleton
changes.detail: One MuonH over all block 2-D params (was four per-shape instances, same math); F.rms_norm RMSNorm/QK-norm, num_trials loop, in-loop train_loader and per-interval step_avg from the updated baseline.

edge.parent_check: Declared parent #5 holds for the method, but the file is a 4-hunk edit of the repo's refactored MuonH script (results/20260430_muonh/train_gpt_simple_muonh.py), which ported #5 onto the updated baseline skeleton with a Gaussian init that no longer zeroes the head. Relative to that file only train_steps, the aux AdamW LRs/wd and the aux cooldown change, which is why #36 (same skeleton and init function) is the nearest code (84 lines). From #36: the AdamW base LRs (scaled) and wd 0.001.
edge.noise: Skeleton differences vs #5's logged script (F.rms_norm RMSNorm, num_trials loop, logging), the single MuonH instance, and comments — two of them stale (the init comment claims the head and proj biases are zeroed; the schedule comment says aux cooldown 0.7 while the code uses 0.85).

techniques.note: Nesterov momentum 0.95 → NS5 (12 iters); magnitude discarded by the hyperball step
all 72 block matrices pinned to init ‖W‖_F; step lr·‖W‖_F then renormalize; no wd
Gaussian std √(0.33/fan_in) × attn.proj 1.25, mlp.proj 3.0, mlp.fc 1.5; q/k/v ×1
MuonH: linear to 0 from step 0; AdamW: flat for 15%, then linear to 0

hparams.schedule.kind: linear decay; MuonH from step 0, AdamW after 15%
hparams.hyperball.radius: per-matrix ‖W‖_F at init (expected ≈16 q/k/v, 20 attn.proj, 48 mlp.fc & mlp.proj)

caveats: Retained comments are stale: the init comment says the LM head and proj biases are zeroed and describes Kaiming-uniform multipliers (code zeroes all biases, uses Gaussian init and leaves the head non-zero), and the schedule comment says aux cooldown 0.7 (code 0.85). The non-zero head init is inherited from the repo's refactored #5 script rather than tuned here, and its effect is unablated; all 10 logs ran this exact script.
